name: Pi-hole
description: FTL binary checksummed via sha1 from the same unauthenticated host; core/web updates are plain git pull, no commit signing.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The FTL installer downloads a binary and a same-host .sha1 file, then checks the binary against that value; the core/web update path fetches and compares Git revisions and can pull new code. The source supports the recorded narrow transport-plus-same-channel hash/update behavior, without an independent signature trust root.
limitations: The source does not establish signed commits or an independently authenticated hash channel.
Snapshot is a newly retrieved default branch, not the historical study revision.
